newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha touch softer, but slow ahead of Easter.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha touch softer, but slow ahead of Easter.

text.p: Naphtha was quitened on Thursday as the market eased gentlly into the Easter break.
A weak tone in the crude market dealt a blow to naphtha bulls. A closing Asian arb window was also forcing players to reassess their options.
"Everything is pretty slow, most things have been already," said one trader.
Full range was pegged $1-2 a tonne easier around $187-190 cif NWE although swaps were reluctant to move off the higher ground.
